design.BASE: same underlying model; direct answer without FOIL/Mastermind benchmark protocol
design.FOIL_MM: same underlying model; frozen Frontier-Exam FOIL plus Mastermind final causal-defect pass
design.assignment: deterministic disjoint subsets within one conversation to avoid same-item answer contamination
design.causal_limit: Disjoint subsets are weaker than isolated same-item randomized A/B executions; no significance or leaderboard-equivalence claim is made.

ci_scored_runs.interpretation: Null pilot result; the benchmark-only FOIL/Mastermind protocol did not improve accuracy on this sample.

legacy_manual_pilots.warning: Not reproduced by the current CI harness; retain as exploratory historical evidence only.
Measures freshness/evidence routing on a custom holdout; not a standardized benchmark.

discarded_pilots.reason: BASE saturated at or near 100%; discarded as non-discriminating rather than reported as evidence of FOIL gain.

publication_boundary: These results are exploratory research-software pilots, not official HLE, ARC-AGI, GPQA, or SimpleBench submissions and not evidence that FOIL generally improves GPT-5.6 Sol.
